Method of Attack: JavaScript e-commerce skimmer that removes itself from memory after exfiltrating stolen data; uses unique obfuscation method and loader; loads dynamically to avoid static malware scanners; uses unique encryption parameters for each victim to obfuscate malicious code; removes itself from memory when detecting dynamic analysis or after successful data exfiltration; skimmer added to merchants' checkout pages using a script tag; loader downloads skimming code from C2 server and executes in memory; skimming payload decrypts to JavaScript resembling page rendering code; uses XOR cipher to obfuscate skimming code and hard-coded values
Impacted Systems: Multiple online stores from several countries
E-commerce stores from jquery-cycle.com, b-metric.com, apienclave.com, quicdn.com, apisquere.com, ordercheck.online, pridecdn.com domains
Attack Vector: Injected onto compromised e-commerce stores via script tag on checkout pages
Command and control (C2) server hosting skimming code
